description:
You are an investigative journalist at a major newspaper. You are building a secure, organized research bookmark library in Tor Browser for ongoing investigative work. You must complete the following steps:

1. Visit 'https://check.torproject.org/' and confirm Tor is working (the page will show your exit node IP)
2. Visit the DuckDuckGo onion service at 'https://duckduckgogg42xjoc72x3sjasowoarfbgcmvfimaftt6twagswzczad.onion/'
3. On DuckDuckGo onion, search for 'press freedom index reporters without borders'
4. Create a bookmark folder named exactly 'Secure Research Sources' in the Bookmarks toolbar or menu
5. Bookmark the DuckDuckGo onion homepage (the .onion URL, not the clearnet one) in that folder with the title 'DuckDuckGo Private Search'
6. Bookmark the check.torproject.org page in the same folder 'Secure Research Sources' with the title 'Tor Exit Node Checker'
7. From the DuckDuckGo search results for 'press freedom index reporters without borders', bookmark the first search result in a NEW folder named exactly 'Press Freedom Research'

All bookmarks must use the exact folder names and bookmark titles specified. You will need to use the Bookmarks menu (star icon, or Bookmarks > Manage Bookmarks, or Ctrl+D to add) to create folders and organize bookmarks.
